breakdown.description: ΔL/L_0 is engineering strain; true strain is ln(L/L_0).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the incorrect formula ε_t = ΔL/L_0 (engineering strain) and computes 0.15 as the result. It does not use the correct true strain formula ε_t = ln(L/L_0), which would yield ln(57.5/50.0) = ln(1.15) ≈ 0.1398.
